name: canvas

frames.best_why: Shows all five connected nodes laid out on the field with no cursor obscuring any of them.

tagline: A dark node graph of an email workflow that pans as you scroll.
summary: A zoomable workflow canvas showing trigger, agent and tool steps connected by thin lines. Scrolling pans the field and clicking a node selects it.
appearance: A near-black full-screen field holds five small bordered cards laid out left to right and branching. Each card has a tiny category, a title and a dim detail line, joined by faint curved connectors.
behaviour: The whole graph pans when the user scrolls, and dragging across empty space draws a selection box. Clicking a node adds a highlight ring around it.
demo_content: Workflow steps New support email, Classify intent, Search help center, Look up invoice and Draft reply.
search_phrases: visual pipeline with triggers and tools
use_when: You need to show or edit a pipeline of steps as connected nodes on a pannable field.
avoid_when: Node text is tiny and low contrast on the dark field, and the canvas is mostly empty space.
customise: Nodes, edges and node types arrive as arrays and components; panning, zoom and selection are passed through to the flow engine.
weight_why: A third-party flow engine renders a pannable canvas with five nodes and SVG edges.

a11y.note: The workflow is mouse-driven; node cards have no roles or names, and the animated edges ignore reduced-motion settings.

issues: Node text is very small and low contrast against the dark canvas.
polish_why: Tidy but extremely dark canvas where node text is small and hard to read.
title: Canvas
